sourceSteps: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
仰卧在球上，直到下背部得到支撑并且上半身与地板平行。
将双手放在脑后或放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，将上身抬向膝盖，躯干向前卷曲。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
acceptedReferenceObservation: Feet and heels flat, knees bent, lower back supported on a stability ball. Endpoint shows a moderate upper-torso crunch toward knees with paws crossed at chest; ball/feet/lower-back support unchanged.
renderingAssumption: Source explicitly permits hands at the chest, used to avoid pulling the neck. Mascot proportions mean no exact measured hip/knee angle is claimed.
